meal.title: Add an average calculation method to a class
meal.objective: Write a method that receives a list of marks and prints their average

voice.script: How do you turn a list of grades into a single number? Calculate the average of a student's marks. We'll add an average method that receives a list of marks and prints the result. First, Python lets us define a function inside a class; we call it a method because it works on an instance, so it always takes self as the first parameter. The method also takes a marks list. Inside, we add all the numbers with the built‑in sum function, count them with len, divide to get the mean, and then use print to show it. Here is the complete class with the new method. Running the program prints the average of the sample marks. A method can process a list and display its average. Write another method that returns the highest mark instead of printing.
